snippet.title: Our Wonderland Horror Visual Novel Announcement Trailer || Wishlist now on Steam!
snippet.description:
A horror-fantasy visual novel following the overwrought trials of a dysfunctional friend group thrust back into the wish-granting wonderland of their youth. Either they face the issues plaguing them or risk dying in horrific ways again… and again… and again.

The complete remastered version of Our Wonderland is coming soon to Steam and the game page is now live! The Steam version will include updated art and features, as well as full controller support and achievements.

Wishlist it now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4329100/Our_Wonderland/

Trailer Music by: Orchestralis and Denisdrummer85 and obtained from envato
Stock particle animation obtained from Vecteezy

#steamgame #horrorgame #indiegame #queerhorror #visualnovel
